title: Cross-Domain Transfer: Applying Software Reliability Engineering Failure Rate Models to AI Security Tools

original_idea.body:
# Cross-Domain Transfer: Applying Software Reliability Engineering Failure Rate Models to AI Security Tools

**Problem:** Software reliability engineering (SRE) has formal models (NHPP, Jelinski-Moranda) for predicting software failure rates over time. These could be applied to model AI vulnerability scanner failure (missed detection) rates.

**Direction:** Fit a software reliability growth model to AI vulnerability scanner detection data across model versions (treating each version as a 'testing interval' and missed CVEs as 'failures'). Forecast the detection rate trajectory. Compare model fit to empirical data from published benchmarks.

**Why it matters:** Reliability models could predict when AI defense tools will reach acceptable performance thresholds, informing deployment timelines and investment decisions.

**Relevant context:** SRE models are standard in software quality engineering. Application to AI security tool performance tracking is novel. AIxCC 37%→86% trajectory provides empirical data for model fitting.
